description.value: Earls is a well-established Canadian casual dining chain offering American-style cuisine with a full bar in a sit-down restaurant setting. The Penticton location is on Main Street and serves both dine-in and takeout customers. It is a solid option for touring cyclists needing a substantial meal with table service in the centre of town.
